about.text: white cheese made from ewe's milk with a semi-soft, crumbly texture and a tangy, nutty flavour.

sources.text: made by Singletons in Longridge, Lancashire; semi-soft crumbly tangy white cheese, probably Lancashire-style (family inferred from texture, not stated); ripening not found
